query: My wireless connection shows connected but websites will not load.

items.title: Wireless icon shows connected but websites do not load
items.content:
Problem: Wireless icon shows connected but websites do not load on Windows 10. The issue happens repeatedly.
Root cause: 
Resolution: Restarted the network adapter and flushed the DNS cache.

items.title: DNS Cache Recovery - Guide 1
items.content: If Wi-Fi is connected but internet access is unavailable, open Command Prompt and run ipconfig /flushdns. Reconnect to Wi-Fi and test again.
